0.0: Ah, you're back. Did the merchant crew rough you up? Heh...your power is useless in the face of hard bargainers, eh?
0.1: Here, give me the information. Let's see... Hm... Ahh yes, this will be most helpful. Well done, Kaiser. Give me my transmitter back, and we'll be done.
0.2: Wait, you GAVE the transmitter to #b#p3001005##k?! What a gullible fool you are! At least I gave you the cheap model, with all the special features removed.
0.3: Hey, if you don't need it, no sense in letting it go to waste. I'll take it, and you can take your info to that old fossil at #b#m401000000##k.

yes.0: You don't know who that is? I'm talking about #b#p3001000##k. Go to #b#m401000001##k. Heh heh heh.

no.0: You don't want to go to #b#p3001000##k? I COMPLETELY understand.

1.0: Kaiser, did you get all the information we need? Because I heard you got led around by the old man and fleeced by the merchants. You may be a dragon on the battlefield, but you're a hatchling off of it.\r\n#L0##bWhat does that even...?#l\n#k
1.1: Anyways, did you give the cookies to that old man?\r\n#L0##bUmm... Let's talk about the intel...#l\n#k
1.2: Hmph! Fine, give me the blasted things.\r\n#L0##bHere you go.#l\n#k
1.3: Ah yes, the mark of the merchant crew. You really DID get fleeced, huh?

yes.0: Hm, this is just what we needed. Give me a moment to go over this.
yes.1: Also, I believe #b#p3001009##k has something to ask of you. You wouldn't want to disappoint, would you?

npc.0: Take the envelope to #b#p3001000##k over at #b#m401000001##k.

item.0: You didn't lose the information, did you? Seriously.
